done_when: A queued CI event whose workflow has been rerun since is dropped or replaced by the current result before delivery, and a test covers a failure followed by a rerun

known.title: Not done: A queued CI failure can still be delivered after its workflow reruns

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. If a failure is queued while the pane turn is busy and the workflow is rerun within the next minute, `forge next` can still return the failed result from the 60-second GitHub cache (`src/forge/board.py:101`). On turn completion, this line finds the old workflow ID in that cached snapshot and submits the stale failure. The new test advances `FORGE_NOW` by a full minute between responses (`tests/test_mod_plugin.py:248`), so it never exercises delivery during the cache window. The Done-when requirement that the queued event be dropped or replaced before delivery remains unmet in this normal sequence.

why: The pane can deliver a queued CI failure after that workflow's rerun has started, because delivery checks only that the item still exists
